description: Look up a named sBPF opcode constant, ISA version flags, or disassemble pasted Solana program instruction bytes. Free, no payment, no RPC. Pass topic=opcode|version|disassemble|catalog. For an opcode pass slug, name, or opc. For disassemble pass bytes (hex or base64) and optional version (v0–v4). This is a disassembler, not a virtual machine, and it does not execute the program.

bytes.description: Instruction bytes as hex or base64, for topic=disassemble.

name.description: Opcode constant or mnemonic, for example ADD64_IMM or add64.

slug.description: Opcode, version or guide slug, for example add64-imm or v2.

topic.description: What to look up. Defaults to catalog, or disassemble when bytes are set.

version.description: ISA version v0, v1, v2, v3 or v4. Defaults to v0 for disassembly.

name: lookup_solana_sbpf
title: sBPF opcodes and bytecode disassembler (free)
